name: Li Xiaohong
current_role: Co-actual controller and shareholder (~6.72%), Luoyang Jalon Micro-nano New Materials Co. (688357.SH)
profile: Li Xiaohong is listed alongside chairman Li Jianbo as an ultimate controller of Luoyang Jalon Micro-nano New Materials, a Luoyang, Henan maker of molecular sieves and activated alumina founded in 1998 and listed on Shanghai's STAR Market in 2019. Her wealth derives from that stake.
interesting_fact: Jalon Micro-nano, founded in 1998 as Luoyang Jianlong Chemical, makes molecular sieve powders and molded molecular sieves used in industrial gas separation and purification; it listed on the STAR Market in 2019.
notes: Controller listing (Li Jianbo 27.71%, Li Xiaohong 6.72%) per basic.10jqka.com.cn/688357/holder.html. Her own executive role and relationship to Li Jianbo not confirmed in sources read. Low public profile; route via company IR / chairman Li Jianbo.

name: Peng You
current_role: Chairman, Anhui Coreach Technology Co., Ltd. (002983.SZ), Hefei
profile: Peng You is chairman and, with his wife Wang Lingli, co-actual controller of Anhui Coreach Technology (Xinruida), a Hefei company founded in 2012 that makes display backlight modules, quantum-dot and Mini LED display modules, automotive displays and healthy smart lighting systems; it is listed in Shenzhen.
interesting_fact: In a 2022 China Securities Journal interview Peng said Coreach was pushing into semiconductor packaging, in-car displays and smart sensing, had IATF16949 automotive certification and had already sent Mini LED display samples to local carmakers.
deep_cut_fact: Peng told China Securities Journal (May 2022) that Coreach was developing 570nm-plus wavelength light sources paired with sensors to shine into skin tissue, so they could serve as heart-rate modules in smart wearables.
notes: Peng You and Wang Lingli are husband and wife and joint actual controllers per the IPO prospectus (SZSE disclosure). A third-party data source has listed him as CEO with a ~55% stake. Best route is the company board office.

name: Yan Yong
profile: Listed by Hurun China (2009-2014) with Yan Yu, wealth attributed to 'Xingyao' (real estate). Searches did not find a source tying Yan Yong (颜勇) to a specific Xingyao-named developer, so the person could not be identified.
notes: Unresolved. Possible candidates (Hangzhou Xingyao Real Estate Development Group; Hangzhou developer Xingyao 兴耀房产) were not linked to Yan Yong in any source read. Check China's enterprise credit registry for legal representative before outreach.

name: Shen Yongmin
profile: Listed by Hurun China (2006-2008) with wealth from 'Jindu Group' (property). Searches in English and Chinese (沈勇民 金都集团) returned no source confirming his role or the specific company, so identity could not be verified.
notes: Unresolved; last appeared on a rich list in 2008. Several Chinese companies are called Jindu (金都), so do not assume which one without registry confirmation.

name: Liu Liqin
current_role: Co-actual controller (with chairman Gao Weiquan), Jiangxi GETO New Materials Corp. (300986.SZ)
profile: Liu Liqin is named with chairman Gao Weiquan as an actual controller of Jiangxi GETO New Materials, a supplier of aluminium formwork systems for building construction founded in 2011 and listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in April 2021. Before the IPO the two indirectly held about 64.8% via Zhuhai Kaiyue and three Zhuhai partnership platforms.
interesting_fact: GETO is described as a leading Chinese provider of aluminium formwork (reusable moulds for pouring concrete walls and floors), founded 8 Dec 2011 and listed in Shenzhen on 30 Apr 2021.
notes: Controller status from the 2021 IPO sponsor document (pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202103111470715894_1.pdf). Her own title and relationship to Gao Weiquan not confirmed in sources read; 2025 filings name only Gao as actual controller. Company site reported as www.geto.com.cn (not verified directly).

name: Zheng Youwen
current_role: Former co-actual controller, Great-Sun Foods (Honghui Fruit & Vegetable, 603336.SH), Shantou; control transfer agreed June 2025
profile: Zheng Youwen was, with chairman Huang Junhui, an actual controller of Great-Sun Foods, a Shantou fruit-and-vegetable company covering growing, procurement, pre-cooling, cold storage, grading, packaging and cold-chain distribution, listed in Shanghai in 2016. In June 2025 Huang agreed to sell a 26.54% stake, with control to pass to Suzhou investors.
interesting_fact: In June 2025 Huang Junhui agreed to sell about 151m shares (26.54%) at RMB5.68 each (~RMB860m) to Suzhou Shenze Ruitai; Huang and Zheng also signed a voting-rights waiver, with actual control to move to Ye Tao, Liu Yang and Suzhou Asset Investment Management Group.
notes: Identity based on company disclosures listing Huang Junhui and Zheng Youwen as actual controllers (2016 prospectus; June 2025 equity change report). Completion of the 2025 transfer not confirmed in sources read. Very low public profile.

name: Zhang Yushu
current_role: Shareholder and person acting in concert with her husband Yuanming Tang, controlling shareholder and chairman of Chongqing Qin'an M&E PLC (603758.SH)
profile: Zhang Yushu is the wife of Yuanming Tang, chairman and controlling shareholder (~64.8% in late 2025) of Chongqing Qin'an M&E, an auto-parts maker listed in Shanghai in 2017. She signed a Nov 2025 equity change report as his concert party; she personally holds a small direct stake (0.02%).
interesting_fact: In Nov 2025 Tang agreed to sell 5% of Qin'an to Rao Yiran, as a safeguard for Qin'an's planned purchase of a controlling stake in Anhui Yigao Optoelectronics Technology from Rao and related parties.
notes: Spouse relationship stated in the 2025 filing. Family wealth sits mainly with Yuanming Tang, so approach via the company/chairman. Website taken from the 2017 draft prospectus and may be outdated.

name: Andrew Page
current_role: Executive Chairman, Alfa Financial Software Holdings plc (LSE: ALFA)
profile: British entrepreneur (born 1963/64) who co-founded CHP Consulting in 1990; it rebranded as Alfa in 2016, when he became executive chairman. Alfa makes Alfa Systems, a cloud platform for auto and equipment asset finance. It floated in London in May 2017, when Page was expected to sell shares worth over £180m. He still controls a large stake via CHP Software and Consulting Holdings.
interesting_fact: Alfa's May 2017 IPO at 325p was billed as London's largest float of that year, and the company joined the FTSE 250 that September.
deep_cut_fact: Page co-founded the business as CHP Consulting in 1990 with Justin Cooper and Ian Hargrave. It won its first customer in 1992 and only took the Alfa name, after its core product, in November 2016.
notes: Dec 2025 RNS lists Andrew Page, Executive Chairman, as an enquiries contact via Alfa (+44 (0)20 7588 1800). In May 2024 his holding company CHP sold ~4.9% of Alfa. His appearance on the 2020 Sunday Times list was not independently verified, but the software-wealth match is strong. Low media profile.

name: Zhang Nengyong
current_role: Shareholder (former co-controller and former director), Guangdong Tapai Group (002233.SZ); no current executive role found
profile: Zhang Nengyong was one of three concert parties, with chairman Zhong Liehua and Xu Yongshou, who together held 52.94% of Guangdong Tapai Group, a Shenzhen-listed cement maker based in Jiaoling, Guangdong; he held 16.21%. He left the board in May 2013, the concert-party arrangement ended in Dec 2016, and he sold down shares in 2018-2021.
interesting_fact: The three original Tapai controllers, Zhong Liehua, Xu Yongshou and Zhang Nengyong, were stated to be unrelated, and they formally ended their concert-party agreement on 11 Dec 2016, leaving Zhong (20.30%) as sole actual controller.
notes: Hurun lists the industry as 'Concrete'; Tapai is a cement company. A 2020 filing said he would drop below 5% if planned sales completed. Inactive in management since 2013; very low profile.
